verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a code-review SaaS, for example bulk-triaging findings or bulk-applying actions to many PRs or issues. The evidence pack documents no feature for selecting many items and acting on them at once. What it does show is adjacent: per-PR automatic reviews, a per-PR auto-fix toggle, repository-wide codebase scans, and MCP-based triage. None of these is a documented multi-item bulk action, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
